## Why

ork decided adj 170 (`process.owner-answers`, 2026-10-25): an agent may record, as decided, an option the owner explicitly picked in an interactive question, with `--by` set to the owner and a `--why` that cites the session and date. ork's relays used this for adj 150-170 and later answers. The record then cannot tell an owner's own `adj decide` from an agent's transcription of an owner's pick, except by parsing `--why`. The slicer relay contract work (slicer s399, owner answers path) relies on this being traceable.

## Failing tests

Red first, table-driven; `t.TempDir()` under `.cache/tmp` with an explicit `cli.Env.Root`.
- `adj decide ID OPT --why W --recorded-by NAME --via TEXT`, and `adj reject` and `adj withdraw` with the same two flags, store `recorded_by` and `via` on the record (omitted from the file when empty). `adj show` prints them; `show --json`, `list --json` and `inbox --json` carry them as strings beside `decided_by`.

## Implement

Proposed, for the owner: `adj decide ... --recorded-by NAME --via TEXT` (for example `--via "interactive question, session ID"`), stored with the decision and shown by `show` and `list --json`. Both optional; leaving them out keeps today's records unchanged (C27: decided_by never required).

Owner decisions (2026-11-02): the flags are `--recorded-by NAME` and `--via TEXT` on all three of `adj decide`, `adj reject` and `adj withdraw`, both optional. Absent flags leave records and output unchanged (C27).
